grammar.bodyZh: 计划表、日程只写关键词,常常省掉主语和动词:Monday: calculus at 9:00(= I have calculus at 9:00 on Monday.);Essay 2 due!(= Essay 2 is due!);Study group at 5:00(= I'm going to the study group at 5:00.)。读的时候自己把省掉的部分补上。时间介词照常用:at + 钟点,from… to…;不加冠词的说法也照常:work、go to bed。给自己的提醒常用 Remember: + 祈使句:Remember: don't be late for work!。
